01 · Staff service desk

An action-first shift overview. Scoped requests lead to the exact console; operational spaces and today’s teaching stay separate.

02 · Editorial workspace

Review the chronological event list, see which events you may manage and open a deliberate composer.

Publishing · Event composer

Timing, venue, category and capacity use actual backend fields. An active narrow composer moves ahead of the list and receives focus.

Publishing · Announcement ledger

Your authored notices, their priority and actual audience. No imaginary pinning or notification-delivery guarantee.

03 · Campus administration

Infrastructure and demand, supported by building status and audit context. Unavailable measurements do not become fabricated charts.

04 · People & access

A server-filtered directory with contextual account review. Table scrolling stays inside a keyboard-accessible region.

People · Selected account review

Profile changes, audited role changes, reset and deactivation are separate operations. Critical changes require deliberate review.

People · Staff responsibilities

Assignments supply resource context, not a promise of permission. Policy limitations are made explicit.

People · Assignment composer

Eligible staff and scope catalogues come from the server independently of the directory page. This is an unsaved demonstration draft.

Verified, with explicit limits.

  • 302 unique fixture-backed web tests passed. After final copy/table polish, all 46 new cases, 21 layout checks and five discovery-state tests passed again: 72/72.
  • Build, lint, web/mobile typechecks and static PHP/API checks passed. Four new Laravel tests were written but could not run without PHP/Composer/backend dependencies.
  • Landing: seven source hashes unchanged; strict 1440 × 5065 cold/client-return comparison found zero differing channels after coordination CSS was loaded.
  • Account identity and returned fields must match before success. Roles are not bundled into profile edits. Passwords are not put in toasts or browser storage.
  • Full-page captures show fixed navigation at the original viewport boundary. A selected narrow table may be scrolled to its action column. This is contained scrolling, not page overflow.
  • Fixtures do not certify deployed permissions, database transitions, concurrency, live transport, physical devices, native mobile or assistive technology.

Research: Stride / Terchera for staff operations; CMS UI / Untitled UI explanatory sections for publishing; Room Booking / Stride for oversight; Chavin Wickramatunge’s role-permission grouping / Untitled UI for account governance. Principles were adapted, not source artwork copied. Exact-source and thumbnail limitations are recorded.

Per-page comparisons and subjective reviews: coordination-redesign.md. Verification: coordination-evidence.json. Protected landing: coordination-landing-preservation.json. Canonical progress: web-page-tracker.md.

16 September 2026 · 24/31 signed-in implementations individually reviewed. Remaining: seven admin pages. Login’s final audit and ancillary auth/status screens are tracked separately.
